picks.setup: Director buys after a 9.3% post-earnings drop

picks.risk: Revenue slightly missed and the stock fell 9.3% on the report. One purchase is small against the share price, and the source gives no price or valuation data.

picks.risk: Q3 revenue was $135.89M vs $154.86M expected, a large miss, and the trend is still down. The purchase is small.

picks.risk: P/E is 46.6, Weiss cut it to hold (c+) on Nov 3, and the stock trades under both averages. The buy is small (about $52K).

picks.setup: Beat and raise, up over 4% premarket
picks.why: Adjusted EPS was $5.06 vs $3.89 expected and revenue $9.55B vs $9.35B. 2026 adjusted EPS guidance is $12.50-$12.80 vs $12.22 expected. It is buying a 609 MW Rhode Island plant from Shell for $715M and has a 690 MW Amazon deal.
picks.risk: Premarket gains can fade at the open, and the group sold off hard on Nov 5 on data-center regulation fears. Options had implied about an 8% move.

picks.cat: Board investigation of CEO Jensen Huang (reported Nov 9)
picks.setup: Down more than 4% premarket on the probe
picks.why: Nvidia's board is investigating whether Huang was a target of a foreign intelligence effort after a report of a relationship with a Chinese businesswoman. Huang said he was unfaithful and took full responsibility; Nvidia says it has no reason to believe secrets were compromised.
picks.risk: Details come from media reports and are not independently verified; headlines can reverse the move quickly. The stock had already fallen 9.3% on Nov 5.
picks.soc: Stocktwits retail sentiment was 'extremely bullish' for the week of Nov 2-6 even as the stock fell 8.8%; AltIndex's Nov 10 list shows about 15,400 Stocktwits mentions, up 54% in a day.

picks.why: Homebuilders rallied after Democrats won the Senate and House. UBS says Democratic control could improve the odds of lower tariffs on building materials.
picks.risk: A move this large on a political read can retrace, and mortgage rates are still above 7%. No volume or price level was in the source.

picks.why: argenx agreed to acquire Unnatural Products for up to about $1.15B, including $550M upfront.
picks.risk: The premarket move is small and deal terms can include milestone payments that may never be paid. No price or volume was in the source.

picks.why: SAP rose about 3% after JPMorgan upgraded it to Overweight from Neutral.
picks.risk: An upgrade-driven move can fade, and the article gave no price, volume or target. The software group has been volatile.

picks.why: Closed Nov 6 at $53.07 (+15.4%) after falling 12.2% on Nov 5, still far below its record close of $150.23. Options imply about a 15.4% move on the Nov 9 report (EarningsWatcher, Nov 6); consensus was about -$0.02 EPS on $256.51M revenue.
picks.risk: The Neutron rocket slipped to 2027 and the stock trades near 30x sales. Earnings can gap it either way, and it already bounced 15% going in.

picks.setup: Earnings after a sharp AI selloff
picks.why: Reports after the close Nov 10 (call 5 pm ET). Consensus revenue is about $3.5B (+159% y/y); EPS estimates conflict (about -$1.17 to -$1.55). Options imply about a 21.2% move; the stock fell 9.9% on Nov 4.
picks.risk: AI data-center names are the center of the Nov 5 regulation scare, and the implied move is large. Sources disagree on the EPS consensus.

picks.why: Reports after the close Nov 12; EPS consensus is about $4.06-$4.13 and the market is watching for a Q1 revenue guide above $7.65B. Options imply about a 10.4% move.
picks.risk: Chip equipment is tied to the same AI-capex fears that hit semis on Nov 5, and the guide matters more than the quarter.

picks.risk: Weaker procedure guidance drove the post-earnings drop; da Vinci 5 margin pressure and competition from Medtronic and J&J are cited. The source gives no analyst targets.

picks.cat: Series C preferred fully redeemed (Nov 5 release)
picks.stageN: Up about 181% in one session; the spike may already be priced in.
picks.why: On Nov 5 the company said it redeemed the last 127,097 Series C preferred shares for $1,270,970 cash (agreement dated Nov 2), so no preferred stock or borrowed-money debt remains and no more conversion shares can be issued. It has a Phase 2a trial of Nu-3 in infected diabetic foot ulcers (first patient dosed Sep 24).
picks.risk: The release gives no cash balance or runway, and says the redemption may shorten runway. A 181% one-day move in a sub-$1 name often fades. (Not refreshed Nov 9: price-screener and penny-stock sources could not be opened this run, so this is the Nov 5-6 read.)

picks.cat: Oppenheimer upgrade; Google Cloud TPU host-CPU win (Nov 9)
picks.setup: Upgrade-driven breakout on its best day in six months
picks.why: AMD rose 13% to $508.58, its best session in six months. Oppenheimer upgraded it to Outperform with a $600 target, its EPYC chips will host Google Cloud's TPU 8tx, and its CEO raised the 2027 revenue growth outlook to above 80%. Nvidia fell 4% the same day on a board probe into its CEO.
picks.soc: Stocktwits retail sentiment moved to 'extremely bullish' from 'bullish', with message volume up 277% in 24 hours (Stocktwits, Nov 10).
picks.risk: Part of the move came from Nvidia's trouble, which can reverse. Michael Burry said he would not trade this rally and stays bearish on chip stocks.

picks.cat: Weak Q3 results (Nov 9); Peptides+ program ahead
picks.setup: Earnings gap down with heavy retail chatter
picks.why: HIMS fell 12% to $22.94, its worst session in over three months, then slipped nearly 4% more overnight. Subscribers fell about 100,000 from the prior quarter to 2.8 million. Retail traders are betting the upcoming Peptides+ program and a new board member can revive it.
picks.soc: Stocktwits sentiment jumped to 'extremely bullish' from neutral, with message volume up 8,509% in 24 hours (Stocktwits, Nov 10).
picks.risk: Retail enthusiasm after a sharp earnings drop can fade; the stock is down 29% year to date and fell on shrinking subscribers.

picks.cat: First profitable quarter in two years; Piper Sandler and Goldman raised targets (Nov 9)

picks.why: Moderna posted its first profitable quarter in two years with revenue up 29%, and investors liked its experimental skin cancer vaccine with Merck. It reached about $280.80, a near five-year high, and closed up about 5% on Nov 9.
picks.risk: It is already near a five-year high, so a pullback is possible, and the skin cancer vaccine is still experimental.

picks.cat: REGAL trial hit its 80th event; topline results expected Q4
picks.setup: Binary trial readout ahead; two straight up days
picks.why: The Phase 3 REGAL trial of Galinpepimut-S reached its 80th event, which triggers the final analysis, with topline results expected in the fourth quarter. The stock rose nearly 2% on Monday and is up about 128% year to date. Analysts expect no revenue and a loss of $0.05 per share.
picks.soc: Stocktwits sentiment slipped to 'neutral' from 'bullish', with message volume up 193% in 24 hours (Stocktwits, Nov 10).
picks.risk: A failed trial could drop the stock sharply. The company has no revenue and an operating loss near $10M a quarter.
